title: See when friends are training
summary: Friends and Home show when your friends are working out, active now or were last active, with the workout they are doing. Choose what friends see with separate Online status and Live workouts switches.
changes: Friends shows when each friend is working out, active now or was last active. A friend's workout in progress moves to the top with a Live label, its name and how long they have been training, and stays while their phone is locked between sets. Changes appear as they happen.
Home's Recent Friends Activity lists friends working out first, showing their live workout in place of their last session until they finish.

Settings > Account & privacy > Profile sharing has a Live activity section with separate Online status and Live workouts switches and a preview of what friends see. Both start on, only accepted friends can see them, and turning one off hides it from friends straight away.
